lines.t: I want my silence like a winter cold
Walking through the valley where the cold and smoke
The moon look fragile, hanging thin and pale
Like hope was drifting somewhere past the veil
But you came closer than the breath in my chest
A steady hand when my heart knew less
You lit a flame in the ruin of my soul
And the darkest corner started letting go
Every broken echo, every whisper scar
You turn into a doorway where your mercy is
Every fallen fragment, every buried flame
You spoke it back to life when you called my name
You are the light in the dust and the thunder in the still
The river in the desert, the whisper that can heal
When the night turns gold and the old chains fall
I'll sing your praise forever, Lord of all
You are the dawn in the ashes, the song in my bones
The hand that leads me home when I'm too far gone
When the night turns gold and the storm is through
My heart will keep on rising, Lord, towards you
You planted grace like wildflowers in my chest
Made a cathedral out of rubble's flesh
Every thorn and sorrow that I could not hide
You wore like a crown and turned them into love
Now my hands are lifted like branches in spring Learning how to tremble just to let you in
What was dry and faded, what was cracked and old You've made into a garden where your love takes hold
Every anxious hour, every heavy thread You're weaving into mercy where my fear has bled
Every lonely question, every wandering breath
You answer with a promise stronger than death
You are the light in the dust and the thunder in the still
The river in the desert, the whisper that can heal
When the night turns cold and the old chains fall
I'll sing your praise forever, Lord of all
You are the dawn in the ashes, the song in my bones
The hand that leads me home when I'm too far gone
When the night turns gold and the storm is through
My heart will keep on rising, Lord, toward you
So let the stars bow down, let the waves obey
Let the dark surrender to the dawning day
I was lost like a sparrow in the storm-torn air
Now I'm found in the garden of your endless care
Every fear is fading, every wall comes down Your love is a kingdom, no despair can drown
You turn my morning into morning glow And teach my tired heart what it means to grow
You are the light in the dust and the thunder in the still
The river in the desert, the whisper that can heal
When the night turns gold and the old chains fall
I'll sing your praise forever, Lord of all
You are the dawn in the ashes, the song in my bones
The hand that leads me home when I'm too far gone
When the night turns gold and the storm is through
My heart will keep on rising, Lord, towards you
